A recording with a broken transcript can now be rescued on macOS and Windows.

**Re-transcribe a recording** (#681)

- A recording whose transcript came back empty, cut short or garbled can be transcribed again from its saved audio. Open the recording: when the transcript is empty, a Re-transcribe button sits right where the transcript would be; when there is one, a smaller Re-transcribe button is in the transcript header next to Copy.
- This covers the recordings Parley recovers after an unexpected quit, which are saved without a transcript.
- It uses your current transcription settings and always asks the provider again, rather than reusing an earlier result. When a transcript would be replaced, Parley asks first.
- The new transcript replaces the old one in your library and in cloud sync, and the analysis, action items and brief run again on it. The title, folder and meeting context stay as they were. Speaker names are kept when the same speakers come back.
- If transcription fails, or nothing is recognized, the recording stays exactly as it was.
